title: Implement HTTP security headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and more
acceptance_criteria: Content-Security-Policy header restricts script-src, style-src, img-src, connect-src appropriately
Strict-Transport-Security header set with max-age=31536000 and includeSubDomains
Permissions-Policy restricts camera, microphone, geolocation to 'none'
CSP report-uri or report-to configured for violation monitoring
